summary_zh: 面向单个 GitHub 仓库的主动式编码代理，打包为 DeepSeek Harness 组件。它监听 GitHub 及可选的飞书：当获授权的人请求工作时，创建工作项，在独立的代理会话和目录中处理，并在原对话中答复（例如提交拉取请求）；网页面板展示需要人工处理的事项。它仅在收到请求或团队规则允许时行动。
audience_zh: 适合希望为单个 GitHub 仓库引入代理式工作流程、并愿意在自建环境中审阅和适配代码的研究或开发团队；这是仅作参考的研究原型，并非生产就绪软件，也不是官方 DeepSeek 产品。

evidence.quote: > **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent sess
ion and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.
